headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: Integrate real-time dependency tracking and risk assessment to improve ClearInstall's local-first lockfile and install-surface auditor, ensuring safer npm/PyPI installations. Incorporate Rust support for broader language coverage and enhance user interface for better accessibility.
actions: Add real-time dependency tracking to identify potential risks in dependencies before installation.
Support Rust through the integration of rust-anything or similar projects to cover more languages.
Improve the user interface to make it more intuitive, including a risk assessment dashboard.
